sample_binding: First sorted video from the predeclared representative selection in binding-inventory-06/receipt.json; hash must match before staging and again after copying.
executable_binding_policy: Read the two declared local executable hashes and persist them into this child before creating any decoder process; recheck immediately before each invocation.
processes: One direct ffprobe child and four sequential direct CPU ffmpeg children through production run_bounded. Only run-owned handles may be terminated/reaped; no model, Comfy, browser or GPU process.
cleanup: Exclusive run temp under reports/v0-s2, source copied to an opaque alias, production snapshot cleanup plus removal of the complete owned run root. Persist only hashes, frame time manifest and path-redacted command diagnostics. Authorization expires at terminal receipt; no automatic retry.
limitations: Linux CPU decoder integration evidence only; cannot satisfy the Windows native Comfy public workflow, browser, GPU, performance or Stage acceptance gates.
